whyItMatters: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a dependency that pins a classifier artifact.
actions: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a dependency that pins a classifier artifact.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm pom.xml no longer carries a dependency that pins a classifier artifact.
